title: thelypteris damingshanensis
intro: Thelypteris damingshanensis, commonly known as the Damingshan fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. As a traditional medicinal plant, Thelypteris damingshanensis has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris damingshanensis include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering body temperature. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
